training.task_balance: two retention pairs and two acquisition pairs per batch

mechanism.gate: per-expert learned scalar gates the complete proposed transition, including decay
mechanism.inputs: current visible address/value, expert read and read norm, expert identity; no query, target slot, task role, phase, future evidence or labels
mechanism.always_update: same initialized parent weights and architecture, gate forced to one and gate parameters frozen

endpoints: paired seed learned-minus-always gaps with exploratory 95% t intervals
rules: Freeze this local development protocol before any new training or measurement; not a scientific preregistration.
Both arms start with identical parameter tensors and receive exactly the same batches, labels, optimizer hyperparameters and number of steps.
Only protection-gate activation differs; the always-update gate parameters are unused and frozen. Active parameter counts differ and must be reported.
No checkpoint/hyperparameter/threshold selection from evaluation results.
Current queries occur only after the full history and intervening writes. Gate decisions cannot observe queries or target role.
Retention queries a hidden latent address in earlier history; acquisition queries a hidden latent address in a new write. All addresses and queries are independently noisy views.
Paired histories differ in one target payload only; current query/bit and every other event are identical. Targets are balanced and opposite.
The no-intervening-write control uses evaluator knowledge of the history boundary and is not a runtime architecture or deployment policy.
Reset must have exact 50% accuracy for both tasks; no-intervening-write must have exact 50% on acquisition pairs.
Retain every seed and cell, all checkpoints, training gradients/losses, predictions, dataset fingerprints and gate/write traces; reload and replay all evaluation.
A gain on retention with loss on acquisition is a tradeoff, not unqualified architectural improvement.
This uses a new development implementation of the existing noisy-latent family, not an untouched confirmatory family, modern-baseline parity, or a general memory result.
The synthetic query may be ambiguous under near collisions; score matched classical baselines and do not claim perfect observability from oracle identity.
No SOTA, sublinear total work, hardware speedup or full multimodal/verifier claim.
